reader.requirement: At --std 85 the footing start (integer-2 or data-name-2's value) must be > 0 and <= the page size, and the footing area is the page-body lines from the footing start through the page size INCLUSIVE, so a WRITE that leaves LINAGE-COUNTER anywhere in [footing, page size] is in the footing area (end-of-page, VII.4.7.4 GR18); an out-of-range data-name value is a 'must' on the program (undefined), an out-of-range literal is refused by SR3 / III.2.

reader.notes: EvaluateLinage applies the >0 and <= page-size test exactly when the FOOTING phrase is present (Footing nullable), and PositionOnLogicalPage raises end-of-page at counter >= footing with no upper clamp, matching the inclusive footing area. A data-name violation answers I-O status 90 and latches until CLOSE, which 1985 leaves undefined.
